body:
**Starts** once #191 is merged. #63 is already merged.

## Why

Workers read the facts for their stops and stays from code, and save their candidates to the trip, with tools on the `trip` server. The coordinator writes only what takes its judgment into a worker brief, so it never copies facts out of a read, and can't copy them wrong (technical spec 5.3). These tools are plain code, so they're built and tested on their own, before the first worker (#60).

## Design

- [Technical spec](https://github.com/nimbusscale/road-trip-agent/blob/main/design/technical-spec.md), sections 5.3 (what `read_worker_brief_facts` returns), 6.3 (a stay's activities), and section 9 (tiers).
- [Tool design](https://github.com/nimbusscale/road-trip-agent/blob/main/design/tools.md), sections 2.1 (the candidate tools and `read_worker_brief_facts`), 2.5 (`look_up_stay_weather`), and 3.
- [Domain model](https://github.com/nimbusscale/road-trip-agent/blob/main/design/domain-model.md), for candidate sets and stays.

## Open questions

- None.

## Do

- Add `read_worker_brief_facts` on the `trip` server (tool design 2.1). Reuse `read_itinerary`'s line formatting, so its reply reads like a scoped read.
- Add `add_lodging_candidates` and `add_stop_candidates` on the `trip` server (tool design 2.1).
- Move each stay's activities from `look_up_stay_weather`'s reply to `read_worker_brief_facts`'s stay reply (tool design 2.1 and 2.5). #63 built them into the weather tool, before #191 moved them.
- Leave all three out of the coordinator's definition, which #197 adds. No agent is given them until #60.

## Done when

- Tests show `read_worker_brief_facts` returns each fact in tool design 2.1 for a stop and for a stay, with the Moab trip (domain model section 5.2), and errors for a check-in and a bad ID.
- Tests show each candidate tool saves a set, and its reply has one line per candidate.
- `look_up_stay_weather`'s reply no longer lists the activities.

## Ends in

A PR.

**Settled in:** chat. Propose each answer to Joe in chat first, and write it in once he agrees.
